decisions.reason: The displayed fixed-point equality omits (a-d)v from its imaginary part. For (a,b,c,d)=(0,1,-1,1) and tau=1/2+i sqrt(3)/2, the true quadratic tau^2-tau+1 is zero but the displayed imaginary part is sqrt(3)/2. This is a false algebraic equality used to obtain u, hence a logic defect. Replacing it by (2bu+a-d)v i justifies u=(d-a)/(2b) and v^2=(4-t^2)/(4b^2) without changing the claim.

For f(z)=z one has f(z+omega)=f(z) for every z only when omega=0, so Per(f)={0} cannot contain a full lattice. The unconditional containment in the Definition is false (logic defect). Removed only that unconditional clause; the exact equivalence f is Lambda-elliptic iff Lambda is a subset of Per(f) retains the required hypothesis and all intended claims.
